contract_sections: §4.5 Required backend and product capability inventory

disposition_meanings.replace: Subsystem must be deleted/rebuilt clean-room against measured reference product behavior; residual partial surfaces alone are not parity.
disposition_meanings.rework: Keep module boundary if useful, but rewrite observable product behavior, lifecycle, and journeys to match the better reference contract while preserving hard Harness invariants.
disposition_meanings.retain-seam-only: Keep Harness authority/safety/data seams (event append, replay purity, permission-before-execution, redaction, runtime/TUI config separation); do not treat current full product behavior as reference-correct.
disposition_meanings.retain-with-reference-proof: Only when L2–L5 (or equivalent measured product) evidence proves the subsystem already matches the frozen reference (none claimed for core inventory).

policy.a_core_audit_note: Inventory + deliberate classification + 26/26 comparison receipts under artifacts/qa-evidence/20260717-tui-reference-parity/receipts/core-audit/. First-party product landed for former empty-surface rows (plugins/acp/sandbox) and auth sleep-wake / MCP OAuth / demote / worktree lifecycle; those rows are now rework+partial. A-CORE-AUDIT remains incomplete until measured black-box reference captures, residual rework owner evidence, and Phase 9 same-revision gates close. `complete` on a row means comparison receipt authored (Harness capture + black-box method + disposition + residuals), not product parity or L2–L5 visual proof.

subsystems.rationale: Coordinator remains the sole event-append, task-scheduling, permission-resolution, hook, compaction-trigger, and lifecycle authority. Product turn choreography, background orchestration polish, and recovery UX may be reworked around this seam; authority must not move into TUI/CLI/tools.
hard_invariants_preserved: coordinator owns all event appends
permission resolution precedes tool execution
cancellation precedence over late task results
hooks and lifecycle transitions stay coordinator-owned

subsystems.rationale: EventEnvelopeV1 / EventV1 append-only schema is the source of truth. New variants may be added for reference capabilities, but events stay immutable, contiguous-seq JSONL, never rewritten in place.
hard_invariants_preserved: events are append-only and immutable
contiguous seq ordering
no in-place event log rewrite

subsystems.rationale: Replay and projections must remain pure rebuilds from events for UI/resume/export/debug. Presentation of projected state is free to rework; replay must not execute providers, tools, hooks, MCP, network, or CLI.
hard_invariants_preserved: replay purity (no side effects)
projections are event-derived only
session inspection tools read replay-derived data only

subsystems.rationale: Public config ergonomics, settings registry, schema generation, migrations, and effective-value inspection need reference-level polish (§4.8) while keeping runtime vs TUI contracts separate and credentials out of config.
hard_invariants_preserved: runtime and TUI config remain separate public contracts
secrets never persist in config files or effective-config output
config validation is side-effect free

subsystems.rationale: Permission-before-execution, ask/deny/allow resolution, and durable grant policy are hard safety seams owned by core/coordinator. UI dock choreography is separate (TUI disposition); do not bypass checks from agents, UI, providers, or tests.
hard_invariants_preserved: permission checks precede tool execution
headless ask denies unless scenario resolves
worker redelegation bypasses remain blocked

subsystems.rationale: Tree/fork/clone/title/resume surfaces wired through the sessions CLI + TUI; event-derived lineage kept. Comparison closed by the Packet 3.1 receipt: materialization from stable event prefixes, fork and clone rejection of running/active sources, corrupt and non-contiguous log rejection, and side-effect-free inspection verified against the documented reference session lifecycle contract. Residuals: prompt-rewind product UX (projection+atomic demoted to incomplete), worktree-aware lineage polish, measured L2-L5 parity (Wave 4).
hard_invariants_preserved: lineage materialization from stable event prefixes
fork/clone reject active or writer-locked sources
session inspection remains side-effect free

subsystems.rationale: JSONL event store, append sequencing, and writer-lock recovery are persistence authority seams. Directory layout and recovery UX may rework; do not mutate stored events or non-contiguous sequences.
hard_invariants_preserved: append-only JSONL persistence
writer-lock recovery without event rewrite
contiguous seq enforcement

subsystems.rationale: Create + CoW fastpath product paths exist and are wired (Ctrl+W / new_live); list/select/cleanup has no public surface (worktree.list_select_cleanup demoted to incomplete). Comparison closed by the Packet 3.1 receipt: collision-safe create with rollback, distinct worktree paths + isolated event logs, COW overlay skipping .git, and removal guards verified by owner tests against the documented reference worktree contract. Residuals: full PTY end-to-end parity vs reference (section 4.6) and select/switch UX (Wave 4).
hard_invariants_preserved: path safety and permissions resolve against active worktree root when selected
partial creation attempts rollback
no accidental sharing of mutable session state across concurrent worktrees

subsystems.rationale: Workspace roots and path helpers are real and wired into tool path safety; folder-trust enforcement closed in the Wave 2 sandbox audit. Black-box comparison against the documented reference workspace contract closed by the Packet 3.1 receipt: root resolution, external-path normalization rejecting parent traversal, and redacted labels verified by owner tests. Residuals honest: remote/workspace-binding product surface (remote.workspace_hub demoted to incomplete) and measured L2-L5 reference parity (Wave 4).
hard_invariants_preserved: external-directory permission safety
workspace roots resolve via helpers not hardcoded paths

subsystems.rationale: OpenAI-compatible transport, mock/cassette, and catalog metadata exist. Reference-visible protocols, fallback/retry polish, and error presentation need clean-room extension while redacting provider metadata before persistence.
hard_invariants_preserved: provider metadata redacted before events/artifacts
no raw requests/responses/auth headers in persistence
cassette/mock paths stay deterministic for offline proof

subsystems.rationale: Native tool surface is substantial but must be audited capability-by-capability against reference tool journeys; schema/id parity tests do not prove reference product completeness. Permission-gated execution stays mandatory.
hard_invariants_preserved: permission-before-execution for gated tools
path safety for filesystem tools
canonical tool ids remain stable public contract

subsystems.rationale: Config-backed MCP registration (stdio + streamable_http shapes, invalid id and legacy-shape rejection), generic call wrappers with stateful stdio sessions (integration-tested against a live fixture server), and offline doctor readiness. Comparison closed by Packet 3.2 against the documented MCP config/tool contract. Residuals: the OAuth/remote transport product path (mcp.oauth_remote_transports demoted in Wave 2 — local stand-in only) and measured live-peer operator journeys (Wave 4). Doctor/config validation never executes MCP network.
hard_invariants_preserved: doctor/config validation do not silently execute MCP network
MCP secrets redacted in support/doctor output

subsystems.rationale: Native LSP tool surface (request-shape parsing, cliproxy-compatible schema, install decisions), builtin rust/typescript server specs with injected process starters (tests never spawn), and unsupported-language probes that stay recoverable with stable messages; the lsp permission kind stays policy-gated. Comparison closed by Packet 3.2 against the native tool catalog contract. Residuals: the persistent code graph (code.persistent_graph demoted in Wave 2 — index/probe only) and live LSP server parity + reference code-intelligence surfaces (Wave 4).
hard_invariants_preserved: unsupported LSP probes remain recoverable in prompt path
permission kind lsp stays policy-gated

subsystems.rationale: task/background_output/background_cancel, coordinator-owned wait-any/wait-all, and foreground-demote-to-background product paths exist and stay wired with scheduling authority in the coordinator. Comparison closed by the Packet 3.1 receipt: late results after cancel become TaskResultLate, workers cannot spawn agents directly, and wait-mode parsing fails closed — verified by coord tests + native tool tests against the documented reference agent-task contract. Residuals: multi-agent team product surface (team registry demoted to incomplete) and reference multi-agent lifecycle polish (Wave 4).
hard_invariants_preserved: coordinator owns task scheduling and cancellation
late results after cancel become TaskResultLate
workers cannot spawn agents directly

subsystems.rationale: Compaction is explicitly redesignable: compare triggers, token accounting, summarization, checkpoints, interruption/retry/recovery, transcript markers, and user control against the better reference behavior. Preserve append-only event truth and replay purity — compaction writes checkpoint artifacts/events and must not rewrite events.jsonl.
hard_invariants_preserved: append-only event log (no rewrite of events.jsonl)
replay purity after compaction checkpoints
redaction of secrets in summaries/checkpoints

subsystems.rationale: CLI auth login/logout/list and the StoredCredential store (per-provider files, atomic versioned writes) are wired through the harness auth CLI; the sleep/wake DECISION pipeline exists but its refresh execute/loop is unwired, and browser OIDC start/complete is a hardcoded-Unavailable stub. Comparison closed by Packet 3.2 against the documented auth/privacy contract with secret-never-printed and idempotent-logout evidence. Residuals: browser OIDC backend and sleep/wake execution (auth.browser_oidc_sso + auth.sleep_wake_credential_refresh demoted in Wave 2), enterprise SSO journeys and platform-native sleep hooks pending measured reference evidence (Wave 4 / Packet 1.4 blocker).
hard_invariants_preserved: credentials never printed by doctor/auth CLI
auth material kept out of config files
redaction of secret-bearing fields in exports

subsystems.rationale: Redaction before persistence, summaries, support exports, and artifact indexes is a hard privacy/safety seam. Expand coverage as new surfaces appear; do not weaken scanners to obtain polish.
hard_invariants_preserved: redact secrets before persistence and export
no raw API keys, bearer tokens, cookies, or PEM blocks in support bundles
provider metadata redaction before event/artifact write

subsystems.rationale: AppState/projection/intent/overlay-stack seams are Harness-owned interaction state machines (disposition stays retain-seam-only). Comparison closed by Packet 3.3 with hard invariants proven: replay mode disables the composer (composer_disabled gate + focus redirection — exact tests), replay navigation never emits live intents, deterministic render/replay tests cover the presentation-only contract, and permission modal lifecycle stays coordinator-facing. Residuals: reference shell choreography/pixel parity (Wave 4; painters are out of this seam).
hard_invariants_preserved: TUI remains presentation-only for runtime authority
replay mode must not emit live submission intents
permission modal lifecycle stays coordinator-facing

subsystems.rationale: Presentation layer is disposable per §12. Painters/layout/theme must be rebuilt against measured reference anatomy; residual glyphs or compose-first topology alone are not parity. Detailed file-level disposition lives in docs/tui-reference-module-disposition.v1.json.
hard_invariants_preserved: no production code reads reference captures or golden hashes
identity substitutions only where contract allows
runtime authority stays out of painters

subsystems.rationale: CLI→TUI handoff plus tui/run/prompt/replay commands are real, thin-shell product surfaces: the handoff test suite (tui_cli 01-03: help does not expose headless flags, replay bootstrap fallback, invalid config fails without side effects; run_cli: out-file + durable run logs + interactive permission flow; prompt_cli 01-05: endpoint + parity with run; replay_sessions_cli 01-10: inspection/export/fork surfaces). Comparison closed by Packet 3.3 against the documented CLI contract (thin shell; no coordinator/permission/event-append authority in CLI modules). Residuals: incomplete live journeys reworked in Wave 4 against reference captures.
hard_invariants_preserved: CLI does not own event append or permission authority
replay/session commands stay inspection/export surfaces
runtime/TUI config loading via shared discovery helpers

subsystems.rationale: V1 extension manifests are deliberately descriptor-only: no runtime tool registration, MCP launch, provider decorators, or session mutation. Retain the descriptor seam; full plugin host is a separate replace surface (plugins).
hard_invariants_preserved: descriptor-only V1 (no plugin host)
no external code loading via extension manifests
no session mutation through descriptors

subsystems.rationale: Doctor reports local readiness without network side effects: `harness doctor` (Commands::Doctor dispatch) prints 'local readiness only — not provider execution proof' with provider credentials, model references, native tool catalog, formatter, and workflow profile readiness sections (owner tests 02/02b/02c/02e/02f). Comparison closed by Packet 3.3 against the documented doctor contract; redaction pinned (secrets never in doctor output). Residuals: schema-aware reporting polish and expanded capability diagnostics (Wave 4 scope, never live provider/MCP execution).
hard_invariants_preserved: doctor does not make provider or MCP network calls
secrets redacted in doctor output
config validation remains side-effect free

subsystems.rationale: Support export bundles are replay-derived and redaction fail-closed: `sessions export` writes the JSON bundle, redacts secret payload shapes, scans the bundle, and includes artifact index + readiness/config summaries (owner tests 08/08b/09); missing sessions fail closed with a structured error; crash-recovery + foreign-import journeys covered (test 10). Comparison closed by Packet 3.3 against the documented support-export/privacy contract. Residuals: reference support-workflow completeness polish (Wave 4).
hard_invariants_preserved: export is redacted and secret-scanned
export derives from replay/session data not live execution
no credential material in support bundles

subsystems.rationale: Backend primitives are real and tested — extension_manifest descriptor-only V1 parsing (host-behavior rejection, deny_unknown_fields), ExtensionDescriptorRegistry atomic persistence, plugin lifecycle install/activate/deactivate with load receipts — but there are zero production consumers: no CLI, TUI, or coordinator surface registers, activates, or lists extensions (plugins.runtime_lifecycle and plugins.descriptor_manifest demoted in Wave 2). Stays honest partial. Blockers: operator surface closure needs a deliberate product decision; hosting needs a new coordinator-owned plugin runtime design per the root AGENTS anti-pattern guard; no .so/wasm host, no marketplace.
hard_invariants_preserved: plugin execution must not bypass permission-before-execution
descriptor-only manifests are not a full marketplace host
secrets remain redacted

subsystems.rationale: The only implementation is FileAcpTransport — an explicit local mock (file marker + frame journal, payload echo, no protocol exchange) with zero consumers anywhere in the product. No ACP protocol peer, no IDE/editor transport, no coordinator-owned ACP handling exists (the acp.agent_mode capability row was demoted in Wave 2). Stays honest partial. Blocker: closing the comparison requires a real ACP transport design plus product surface.
hard_invariants_preserved: coordinator remains authority for side effects
replay purity for any recorded ACP sessions
permission-before-execution for tool calls from ACP

subsystems.rationale: Coordinator-owned sandbox policy/profiles, Landlock child enforcement via bash pre_exec (opt-in HARNESS_OS_SANDBOX_POLICY), and the folder-trust deny-before-spawn gate wired into bash validation. Comparison closed by the Packet 3.1 receipt: structured availability probing, fail-closed plan preparation, and gate semantics (bare-name passthrough, repo-local deny on missing/deny trust, no parent-path bypass) verified by owner tests against the documented reference trust/sandbox contract. Residuals: native Seatbelt/Windows backends, operator trust-grant UX, measured confinement parity (Wave 4).
hard_invariants_preserved: permission-before-execution for bash
external-directory safety
no silent elevation of sandbox policy
folder trust distinct from operator permission approval
